name: Super Cars Adventure
author: GaLazo
summary: Drivable cars and a whole city inside Super Bear Adventure, with party and online features.
description: Super Cars Adventure adds a large collection of drivable cars and a city to build around them, all built into the game's own world. It includes its own HUD, sounds and music, and online party features. This is an SBA pack: it carries native code, Java code and its assets together.
